text: effects/capabilities CAP-1 (Q1 a2): a `@[verify]` predicate may only read the clock; any other effect it reaches (a write, a sleep, a native call, a call nothing classifies), directly or through helpers and refinement-typed params, is E1104; its Time counts in the fn's row and seeds callers' inference, so a closed row is E1310 (M3800-M3802, M3808, M3809).
